newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares end week mixed in summer lull.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares end week mixed in summer lull.

text.p: Shares on the United Arab Emirates informal stock exchange ended the week to Thursday mixed in mostly quiet mid-summer trade.
Of the 27 shares traded on the market, eight rose, four declined and the rest were unchanged, a report issued by the National Bank of Abu Dhabi showed.

Market leader Etisalat, the country's telecommunications company, closed at 1,010 dirhams -- down 10 dirhams on last week's close. The National Bank of Abu Dhabi gained five dirhams, rising from 595 to 600 dirhams.
Dubai Islamic Bank rose five dirhams to 165.
Union Properties lost half a dirham to end the week at 18 dirhams while Emaar Properties added half a dirham to 18.50.
Al-Khazna Insurance slid 30 dirhams to 250 from 280 dirhams.
